description: This file is a C header defining functions related to XR FDC (possibly 'Function Data Controller' or similar). It includes function declarations for retrieving FDC quantity and performing a check with soft and hard limits. It also contains include guards and C linkage specifications.

methods.name: xr_fdc_fd_qty_get
methods.description: Returns the quantity of file descriptors or a similar resource used by XR FDC.

methods.name: xr_fdc_check
methods.description: Performs a check against soft and hard limits, possibly related to resource usage, and conditionally prints information.
